weights_rationale: Offer is current_buyer framing ('operators who could send South Trip clients'), so destination_overlap is the dominant positive signal (28) - we want operators whose descriptions show they already sell France/Provence trips. source_markets is in low_confidence_fields (inferred from EN/ES/DE/FR/IT language switcher, no named partners), so country is capped at 10 per the rule. icp is solid at 18 because target_icp_types (tour_operator + boutique_advisor) is concrete. niche_match at 10 rewards leads explicitly mentioning food/wine/Provence/Marseille; travel_type at 8 covers broader cultural/culinary fit. niche_penalty at 11 trims clearly off-niche specialists (polar, ski, safari-only) without over-rejecting general operators.
prospect_summary: South Trip Travel is a small Marseille-based tour operator and ground provider for the South of France, founded by Florent Tedesco. They design and run private guided experiences across Provence, the Mediterranean coast, Marseille and the Alps - signature products include Marseille classics city tours, private food tours, and wine-and-cheese tastings, plus multi-day Provence itineraries. Distribution today is primarily B2C via OTAs (GetYourGuide, TripAdvisor, Kayak Guide, Bokun-powered), with the website published in EN/ES/DE/FR/IT. The realistic B2B partners are international tour operators and boutique travel advisors who package South-of-France trips and need a reliable local ground operator for guided day-tours, culinary experiences, and tailor-made Provence add-ons.
